description.value: Gratia Bakery & Cafe is a community-rooted café, deli, and patisserie in downtown Maple Ridge, the original location of a two-site BC bakery operating since 2016. Set with views of Blanshard Peak (Golden Ears), it serves house-made breads, soups, sandwiches, and specialty espresso drinks with both indoor and outdoor seating. The menu is adaptable to dietary needs and draws on scratch-baked ingredients throughout.

address.value: 22225 Dewdney Trunk Road, Maple Ridge, V2X 3H8
